RICKY JUAB RAJ 'tsada Residences Mayor Enerio St., Purok 4, Upper Langcangan, Oroquieta, Misamis Occidental Dear Mr. Juab This has reference to your letter dated 22 January 2019 requesting for the Department's opinion on the issue of whether or not Barangay Resolution No. 33 series of 2018 — informing the City Mayor of Oroquieta of the decision of the Sangguniang Barangay members not to recommend anybody for the vacant position in the sanggunian — is legal. Honorable Edmund D. Neri, Sangguniang Barangay member in Upper Langcangan, Oroquieta City, Misamis Occidental, passed away thereby creating a permanent vacancy in the said Sangguniang Barangay. Thereafter, the Sangguniang Barangay issued Resolution No. 33 series of 2018 to inform the City Mayor of Oroquieta its decision not to recommend anybody in the said vacancy. The query submitted is whether or not such act of passing a resolution not to fill a permanent vacancy is legal and sanctioned by the laws. It is our view that the appointment to fill a permanent vacancy upon recommendation of the sangguniang barangay in case automatic succession does not apply is mandatory. Thus, resolving not to recommend is an evasion of a positive duty making the said Resolution not sanctioned by laws. It appears in the attached letter that the vacancy in question is the seventh seat in the Sangguniang Barangay, in which case automatic succession does not apply. Thus, Section 45 of Republic Act No. 7160 (RA 7160), otherwise known as the Local Government Code of 1991, finds application. It states: Section 45. Permanent Vacancies in the Sanggunian. -

(a) Permanent vacancies in the sanggunian where automatic succession provided above do not apply shall be filled by appointment in the following manner: (1) The President, through the Executive Secretary, in the case of the sangguniang panlalawigan and the sangguniang panlungsod of highly urbanized cities and independent component cities; (2) The governor, in the case of the sangguniang panlungsod of component cities and the sangguniang bayan; (3) The city or municipal mayor, in the case of sangguniang barangay, upon recommendation of the sangguniang barangay concerned. (Emphasis supplied). It is categorical in the aforementioned provision that said appointment is mandatory by the use of the word "shall" in the phrase "...shall be filled by appointment in the following manner. It is our view that the recommendation of the concerned sangguniang barangay is also mandatory being an element in the process of the appointment by the city or municipal mayor. Since this duty is mandatory then the Sangguniang Barangay shall faithfully comply with the prescription of the law. Otherwise, noncompliance shall be tantamount to dereliction of duty which is a ground for disciplinary action provided in Section 60 of RA 7160. Furthermore, such resolution not to recommend anybody in the said vacancy may be considered as a waiver on the part of the Sangguniang Barangay. Hence, the Mayor shall not be precluded from filling up the same through his or her appointment absent the said recommendation in such case. This view is, however, without prejudice to the authoritative decision of the courts of competent jurisdiction. Very truly yours, By the authority of the Secretary. C. SACENDONCILLO, CESO 111 Undersecretary
